## Collectify 0.17.4

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

### Pick packs: no more disappearing packs or redraws
- **Cause:** the 0.17.3 performance pass had set long lists to "paint only what's on screen" and to lazy-load thumbnails, which makes Android's WebView leave blank rows and re-draw them while you scroll. On top of that, the whole list was being rebuilt every time you claimed a pack or loaded more.
- **Fix:** those two settings are removed. The list now keeps its rows: *Load more* only adds the new rows at the bottom, and claiming a pack just updates the buttons in place, so your scroll position never jumps and nothing flickers. Thumbnails have a fixed size so rows don't shift as they load, and the per-row shadows, press animations and transitions that caused extra redraws are gone.
- The same blank-row risk is removed from the shop, trade and binder-search lists.

Tested by scrolling the list on an Android emulator and in a desktop browser, not on a physical phone.

## Collectify 0.17.3 - performance pass

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

The effects added in the last few releases were too heavy for many phones. This release removes the biggest costs:

- **No more backdrop blurs.** Dozens of panels, rows and bars were blurring whatever was behind them, every frame, on top of an animated background. They now use solid translucent backgrounds (the look is nearly identical).
- **Background shader is cheap.** It now renders at a fraction of the resolution, at about 15 fps, and stops completely while a sheet, the game, the camera, the card viewer or pack opening is on screen.
- **The mine only draws when it's visible.** It pauses while a sheet (like *Pick packs*) or the pack opening covers it, runs at 30 fps when nothing is moving, and uses pre-rendered glows, crystals and pickaxe instead of re-computing gradients and shadows every frame. The progress text updates in place instead of rebuilding the panel.
- **Pick packs list:** thumbnails load lazily and off-screen rows aren't painted.
- **Pack opening:** removed the big animated blur and masks, simplified the foil wrapper, fewer floating orbs, and the particle layer only runs while particles exist.
- **Holographic cards:** the shader eases to 30 fps when only shimmering, skips the heaviest noise on lower rarities, and renders at a capped resolution.
- **Decorative loops** (button shimmer, coin shine, vault bobbing, spinning frame, binder foil shimmers) are off by default.
- **New "Effects" setting** (palette button): *Auto* measures your phone a couple of seconds after launch and switches to smooth mode if it can't hold ~30 fps; *Full effects* turns everything back on; *Smooth mode* forces the lightest settings.

I could only test this on an emulator, so I can't promise exact frame rates on your phone. If it's still not smooth, set Effects to *Smooth mode* and tell me which screen is slow.

## Collectify 0.17.2

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

### A proper holographic shimmer
The card shader from 0.17.1 was too washed out. It has been rebuilt around how real foil cards look:

- **Rainbow holo with diffraction.** Holo cards get vivid, saturated rainbow bands plus fine diffraction lines, blended so the picture keeps its contrast (no more milky haze). The colours sweep across as you tilt, and the foil is strongest in the art window.
- **Three distinct foils.** *Holo* is a diagonal rainbow; *ultra* rares are warm gold-foil sunpillars; *secret* rares are a violet/blue cosmic nebula with a field of twinkling stars.
- **Sheen and glitter.** A bright streak sweeps across the card following your finger, tiny glitter stars flash as their angle comes round, and a soft glare and rim light track the touch.
- **Finger held = more of everything:** deeper parallax, stronger foil, brighter sparkles, easing back on release. Ultra and secret rares shimmer by themselves.
- Rarer cards also tint the pack-opening backdrop. Rendering resolution is capped so it stays smooth on phones.

Tested on an Android emulator and a desktop browser, not on a physical phone.

## Collectify 0.17.1

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

### Cards, rebuilt
The old "pop" effect (a clipped copy of the artwork shifted over the card) is gone. Cards are now drawn by a WebGL shader:

- **Layered parallax.** A depth map worked out from the card's own picture makes the art slide behind the frame as the card tilts, with nearer parts of the art moving more than the background. A soft shadow from the frame falls across the art as it moves. No clipped copies, no seams.
- **Real foil.** Rare cards get a view-angle rainbow with fine diffraction lines that follows the picture's own light and dark; ultra rares get gold foil and secret rares a cosmic rainbow with a slow aurora. Plus glitter, an etched-relief highlight and a rim light.
- **Finger-driven.** Where you touch is the light and the tilt. Holding your finger on a card deepens the parallax and strengthens the foil and sparkle, easing back when you let go. Ultra and secret rares also shimmer on their own.
- **Where it applies:** pack-opening cards and the full-screen card viewer (zooming in switches back to the sharp photo, so grading is unaffected). If a device can't do WebGL, the plain card with the older CSS foil is shown instead.

Tested on an Android emulator and a desktop browser, not on a physical phone.

## Collectify 0.17.0

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

### Updates and the project site
- **Check for updates.** The ℹ️ About sheet now has an **Updates** section. *Check for updates* compares your installed version with the published release list; if there's a newer one, *Releases page* opens GitHub in your browser so you can download and install it over the app.
- **Checksum check.** On Android the app also computes the SHA-256 of its own installed APK and compares it with the checksum published for that version, so you can see whether your install matches the official file. (It only applies to an install made from the release file.)
- **Website.** Collectify now has a GitHub Pages site explaining the app, its goals and approach, with every release's SHA-256 listed: https://unaveragetech.github.io/collectify-app/

Tested on an Android emulator and a desktop browser, not on a physical phone.

## Collectify 0.16.0

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

### Treasure Box
- **Foil packs, sliced open.** Packs now have a crinkled metallic foil wrapper with ridged crimped seals. Swipe a finger across the top (either direction): a glowing blade follows your finger with sparks, light leaks out of the slit, and the top peels away.
- **3D, "pop" cards.** Revealed cards tilt in 3D under your finger and the artwork lifts off the frame with a shadow and parallax. Rare cards shimmer, and ultra/secret rares are animated on their own. Hold your finger on a card to make the foil, sparkles and art come alive.
- **Hourly pack tokens.** Mint one token an hour; spend tokens in "Pick packs" to buy a pack instantly (boxes still have to be mined).
- **Who's that Pokémon?** A new silhouette challenge every hour (Pokédex gen 1-3, bundled offline). A correct answer pays coins; get one right every hour and the multiplier grows from x1 up to x4. One missed hour is forgiven; a wrong answer resets the streak.
- **Shop.** Buy sleeves (packs of 10), binder cover styles and sticker sets with game coins.

### Binders
- **Customize covers.** Pick a cover style (leather, galaxy, gold foil, holo...), feature cards from the binder, and place stickers (including 151 Pokédex sprites). Drag, resize and rotate everything. Covers show on your shelf.
- **Sleeves.** Sleeve any card from the card viewer (🛡 Sleeve). Sleeved cards get a coloured edge and sheen in the binder and viewer, and a matching card back.

### Trade
- **Digital cards can be traded.** Treasure Box cards can be offered, clearly marked 🎲 DIGITAL with a note that they have no physical equivalent: nothing is handed over in person for them, they move between binders in the app, and they are left out of the market-value totals. Physical cards are labelled "exchanged in person".

### Look and feel
- Frosted-glass header and tab bar, spring-in sheets, glossier buttons, glass cards and screen transitions.

Notes: tested on an Android emulator and a desktop browser, not on a physical phone. Offline two-code trading is still physical-only.

## Collectify 0.15.1

Installs over your existing Collectify; your data is kept.

### Treasure Box
- **Boxes are now a real grind.** A box is one *hardened* block for every pack inside it (12), mined one after another. Each block you break gives you one pack to rip, so a box no longer pays out all its packs for a single block. Products with no market price are valued sensibly (a box is worth a box of packs), so a cheap box now costs 180 coins instead of 8.
- Boxes show their pack-blocks as pips and a stack of waiting blocks behind the active one.
- **Much more visual mine:** glowing crystals, light shafts, an animated rainbow frame, impact shockwaves, critical hits, tap combos (more damage the longer your streak), a pickaxe motion trail, blocks that squash and glow before they break, and coins that fly out when they do.
- **Animated pack-opening backdrop:** an aurora, spinning rays and rising orbs that change colour with each card's rarity and pulse on good pulls.

### Trade
- The trade screens now show a step tracker (Connect, Add cards, Agree, Swap, Complete) with where you are, plus a "Good to know before you trade" section covering Wi-Fi, no money moving through the app, agreement resets, estimated values, and what completing does.

Note: tested on an Android emulator and a desktop browser, not yet on a physical phone.

## Collectify 0.15.0

Installs over your existing Collectify (same signing key) - your binders, wishlist and trades are kept.

### Scanner: fewer nonsense names
- The old scanner read the whole card in one pass and guessed. It now reads several ways, matches the words against the real card names for the game, checks where on the card each word was found, reads collector numbers / set codes, compares the artwork, and combines that into a confidence.
- It says **Confident**, **Likely** or "couldn't read this card" - it no longer fills the list with unrelated cards when the text is unreadable.
- Takes the sharpest of a short burst of frames. OCR engine and English data are bundled, so scanning works offline.
- On our 54-card test set (simulated phone photos) it identified the right card about 65% of the time, against about 24% for the old scanner, with a handful of wrong answers. Real-world results depend on light and focus.
- Scans can take noticeably longer on slow phones than before.

### Camera
- The scanner now starts on the **rear camera**. Change it under the palette button, Preferences.

### Trade
- Rebuilt: one phone shows a QR, the other scans it, and both open the same live trade screen and see each other's cards. Either side can agree or leave; any change resets both agreements. Needs the same Wi-Fi or one phone's hotspot. Offline two-code trading is still there as a fallback.
- Tested here between an Android emulator and a desktop client; not yet tested between two physical phones.

### Treasure Box (new mini-game)
- Buy a pickaxe, upgrade it, pick booster packs/boxes into stone/iron/gold/diamond/obsidian blocks, mine them (tap or let it run), rip the pack with a swipe, flip each card and swipe keep or bin. Keep to a "Treasure Box" binder; dupes go to the dupes bin (recyclable for coins). Daily chest included.
- Game cards are for fun: they carry a 🎲 badge, never count toward your collection value and can't be traded. Coins are only for the game.

### Quality of life
- Undo after removing a card from a binder or wishlist.
- Find a card inside a binder and jump to its page.
- Haptics on/off and default camera in Preferences.
- Fixed an overlapping "Add cards" button on the trade screen.
